paper_title: Dual Modality-Aware Gated Prompt Tuning for Few-Shot Multimodal Sarcasm   Detection
caption: Effect of Prompt Length
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between prompt length and accuracy, with the y-axis representing accuracy in the range of 77 to 81, using a linear scale with tick intervals of 1. The x-axis is labeled "Prompt Length" and spans from 1 to 16, utilizing a linear scale. The orange line, denoted by solid markers (circles), shows an accuracy value of approximately 77 at a prompt length of 2 and decreases to approximately 76 at a prompt length of 14. The red line, also marked with solid circles, starts at approximately 79 at a prompt length of 1 and decreases to approximately 78 at a prompt length of 14. The yellow line, represented by solid markers, begins at approximately 79 at a prompt length of 1 and steadily decreases to approximately 79 at a prompt length of 14.
